paragraphs.text: Skollten is a region of Tamingazin on the continent Otaria on Dominaria .

Not much is known of Skollten, but it is a mountainous land that lies north of the Valley of Tamingazin and southwest of the island of Umber . The continental land just north of Skollten is an icy waste. Skollten is home to a tribe of squat, hairy humans that are mockingly called apes by the viashino of Suderbod . They have an ambassador to the Valley of Tamingazin placed in Berimish . It is a cold land, with snow, wind, and sleet parts of the year, and lies as far north as the northernmost parts of the Terisian Isles .
When the Garan left their faraway home in the north, they passed through Skollten before ending their journey in the Valley of Tamingazin to the south.
